Key to the Grasslike Plants of the Wet Meadow

l. Stems round and hollow between swollen joints; leaves in
   two ranks ........................................... Poaceae
1'. Stems solid or pithy, without swollen joints .............. 2
2. Stems three-sided; leaves in three ranks; each flower be-
   hind a single scale ...................................... 3
2'. Stems round; leaves in two ranks or reduced to sheaths;
   flowers with six small tepals ............................ 4

                             47

WET MEADOW PLANTS

3. Flowers all alike, each with stamens and a pistil; achene
   naked Scirpus microcarpus
3'. Flowers of two kinds; achene enclosed in a sac ...... Carex
4. Capsule with many tiny seeds; leaves hairless ....... Juncus
4'. Capsule with three seeds; leaf margins with long
   soft hairs .......................................... Luzula
